jobs.title: Senior Retirement Implementation Lead
jobs.description:
**Retirement Plan Implementation Lead**

**Position Summary**  
We are seeking a Retirement Plan Implementation Specialist to manage the onboarding of new retirement plan clients, including startups, takeovers, and conversions. This person will coordinate with plan sponsors, advisors, recordkeepers, and internal teams to ensure an accurate and organized transition to ongoing administration.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage implementation timelines, track outstanding items, and keep all parties informed of progress.
* Collect and review plan documents, adoption agreements, prior testing, census data, and other onboarding materials.
* Review plan provisions and coordinate document preparation or amendments with the appropriate team.
* Work with prior providers and recordkeepers to obtain records, reconcile transfer information, and resolve discrepancies.
* Set up new plans in administration and workflow systems, confirming that plan specifications are accurately recorded.
* Coordinate payroll and contribution setup, including reviewing initial data submissions.
* Help plan sponsors understand onboarding requirements, responsibilities, and next steps.
* Identify potential compliance or operational concerns and escalate them for review.
* Complete a thorough handoff to the ongoing administration team, documenting outstanding issues and key plan details.

**Qualifications**

* Prior experience in retirement plan implementation, conversions, onboarding, or administration within a TPA or recordkeeping environment.
* Working knowledge of 401(k), profit sharing, and safe harbor plans.
* Ability to interpret plan documents and identify information needed for accurate setup.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple implementations and meet deadlines.
* Experience with systems such as FT William, Relius, ASC, or PensionPro preferred.
* QKA or other relevant retirement plan credentials preferred.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Integrations Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Description -** **Integrations Implementation Specialist**

**Reports To:** Implementation Team Lead

**Department:** Customer Onboarding  
**Location:** Remote

**Position Type:** Full-Time

**Position Summary**

The Integrations Implementation Specialist is a hands-on, customer-facing member of the Add-On Implementation team within Customer Onboarding. The Specialist owns assigned add-on, integration, and select upsell implementations from kickoff through go-live, for both net-new customers (joining Onboarding at defined milestones) and existing customers (after Account Management closes the sale).

  

Working under the Implementation Team Lead, the Specialist manages a portfolio of projects and coordinates with Account Management, Onboarding, Customer Success, Support, Product, Engineering, and third-party partners to deliver a smooth, consistent implementation experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own assigned add-on, integration, and upsell implementations from kickoff through go-live.
* Validate requirements, complete configuration and testing, and set clear milestones, timelines, and go-live criteria with customers.
* Lead kickoff meetings and keep customers and partners informed throughout each project.
* Coordinate with third-party partners on setup, credentials, data mapping, and integration testing.
* Deliver training and enablement on relevant features.
* Troubleshoot issues, route them to the right team, and escalate risks and product gaps to the Implementation Team Lead.
* Confirm go-live readiness and hand off cleanly to Onboarding, CSM, or Support.
* Keep project records accurate and follow team playbooks, checklists, and SOPs.
* Contribute to documentation, training materials, and process improvements, and share customer and partner feedback with internal teams.

  

**Success Measures**

* On-time, high-quality implementations with minimal rework and escalations.
* Faster time to go-live and time to value.
* Customer satisfaction with the implementation experience.
* Adoption of add-ons, integrations, and upsell products after go-live.
* Reduced implementation burden on Account Management and the broader Onboarding team.

  

**What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

  

* Clear, professional written and verbal communication that adapts to customer and internal audiences.
* Calm, organized, solution-oriented approach to challenging situations.
* Strong collaborator who shares knowledge, accepts feedback, and knows when to escalate.
* Able to manage multiple implementations and competing deadlines, flagging dependencies and risks early.
* Quick to learn systems, integrations, and technical workflows, with strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Comfortable with CRM, support, and project-management tools.
* Customer-focused, with strong ownership and follow-through from kickoff to adoption.

  

**What We'd Be Excited to Find (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Bachelor’s or Associate degree, or equivalent training, preferred.
* One or more years of implementation, onboarding, integration, customer support, or customer success experience preferred, ideally with software or third-party platforms.
* Experience in home care, healthcare, or SaaS a plus.

  

**Working Conditions**

  

* Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals
* Utilization of phone, Zoom, and email to perform job functions
* Manages multiple customer implementations at once and collaborates across time zones

  

**Compensation** **and Benefits**

* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
* Medical insurance premiums are covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental and Vision)
* 401K with competitive company matching.
* Personal time off, sick leave, and holidays.
* Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment.

**About AxisCare**  
*According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.*  
  
*AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more userfriendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 7 other countries. We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment.*

jobs.title: FAN Content Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The Facilitating Attuned Interactions (FAN) Content Training Specialist is responsible for the co-design, development, and maintenance of trainer-led and asynchronous FAN curricula, learning tools, and educational materials. This position provides the FAN team with expertise in current and emerging best practices in training and the use of educational technology.  
  
The Content Specialist collaborates with the team to address training needs throughout the lifecycle of FAN Training, from conceptualization through production, implementation, and evaluation. These educational materials support the training and development of professionals engaged in relationship-based work, including, but not limited to, home visitors, clinicians, practitioners, supervisors, administrative staff, leaders, legal professionals, and medical professionals.  
  
This position is remote.  
  
This is a half-time ($33.00 per hour), externally funded position.

**Essential Responsibilities**
==============================

* Collaborate with the FAN Team to design, develop new curriculum, and update training materials across multiple modalities, ensuring consistency in content, branding, and accessibility.
* Provide administrative support for the development and delivery of FAN training content.
* Maintain the FAN Training Library and manage trainer access through the FAN Training Portal.
* Evaluate existing training curricula and recommend improvements based on adult learning principles and diverse learning styles.
* Analyze participant feedback and partner with the Director of FAN Training and Dissemination to improve training quality and effectiveness.
* Write instructional scripts and produce, edit, and maintain training videos.
* Create graphics, charts, illustrations, and other visual aids to support FAN training.
* Work with the FAN Team and the Instructional Design Department to create engaging asynchronous learning modules, including content adapted for Spanish-speaking audiences.
* Research and implement emerging technologies to improve training design, development, and delivery.
* Manage continuing education unit (CEU) applications and related processes.
* Develop presentation materials and resources, including handouts and PowerPoint presentations for conference presentations.
* Provide technical support for FAN Network Meetings and other trainings.
* Obtain and maintain endorsement as a FAN Trainer, if not already endorsed.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree, instructional design certificate (or equivalent), or comparable professional experience
* Knowledge of FAN Training and willingness to complete FAN Training during onboarding.
* Experience with learning management systems and AI tools preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; familiarity with APA style preferred.
* Excellent organizational, time-management, and multitasking abilities.
* Demonstrated dependability, initiative, and professional accountability.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Spanish-language proficiency preferred.
* Ability to travel up to 10% based on business needs.

**Reporting Relationship**
==========================

* This position reports to the Director of FAN Training and Dissemination.

Our impact and influence are further amplified through our innovative academic programs, applied research, direct services in the community, advocacy, policy and leadership.

jobs.title: Sr. Onboarding Project Specialist
jobs.description:
Cofactr is on a mission to empower those who get the critical work done. We're bridging the gaps left by traditional supply chain management solutions, creating a seamless link between Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) through our innovative BOM to Build Platform, specifically tailored for hardware innovators. Our platform revolutionizes the technical hardware supply chain by ensuring it is precise, efficient, and effortlessly manageable. As a proud member of the Y Combinator W22 cohort, we've seen our revenue grow consistently, supported by substantial venture funding from esteemed VCs, including Bain Capital Ventures, including our most recent Series A capital raise of $17.2M.

  

**The Team**

The Cofactr team is innovative, creative, and collaborative, with diverse professional backgrounds and a passion for solving big problems. We’re hiring team members who are energized by the opportunity to make one of the most complex challenges in the world, the global electronics supply chain, into a scalable and intuitive tool. We value transparency and trust among our team and translate this approach into our evolving product.

  

**The Role**

The Sr. Onboarding Project Specialist owns the project management of every new Cofactr customer onboarding, from the moment Sales hands off a closed deal (starting at the end of the sales cycle) through the CSM-led enablement sessions that get the customer's team using the platform. You will run several onboardings at once, each with its own timeline, stakeholders, and configuration requirements, and keep every one of them moving. The value of this role is improving time to value for every new customer while giving them an excellent onboarding experience and making sure they achieve the outcomes they came to Cofactr for. You will get customers from signed contract to configured, enabled, and placing orders faster, without cutting corners on the setup or the relationship.

You are the coordinator between Sales, Customer Success, and the customer. You review what Sales captured in discovery, close the gaps before configuration starts, drive account setup to completion, and line up the enablement sessions our CSMs lead. Your work lets CSMs spend their time on enablement and account growth instead of logistics, and it gets customers to their first purchase (major value milestone) faster. This role requires ***operational rigor***, a **project management mindset**, **strong communication skills**, **cross functional relationship building**, and the discipline to track many concurrent projects without letting one stall.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Sales-to-CS Handoff:** Own the handoff for every new customer. Review the configuration discovery and intake materials from Sales, identify missing requirements, and resolve open questions with Sales and the customer before work begins. Close the knowledge gap.
* **Onboarding Project Management:** Run each onboarding as a project with a defined plan, milestones, owners, and target dates. Track status across all active onboardings and flag risks early.
* **Account Configuration:** Coordinate and complete account setup based on the reviewed requirements, partnering with Support, Product, and Engineering where needs go beyond standard setup.
* **Setup Review:** Lead the account setup review with the customer's main point of contact to confirm the configuration is right before enablement begins.
* **Enablement Coordination:** Schedule and prepare CSM-led enablement sessions and office hours, including attendees, agendas, and customer pre-work, so the CSM can focus on delivering the session and the customer arrives ready.
* **Customer Communication:** Keep customers informed and accountable throughout onboarding with clear next steps, timelines, and recaps.
* **Documentation and Systems:** Keep onboarding records current in our systems (Notion, Salesforce, Pylon) so Sales, CS, and leadership can see where every customer stands.
* **Process Improvement:** Work with CS leadership to refine onboarding playbooks, intake forms, checklists, and templates as volume grows.
* **Metrics and Reporting:** Track onboarding metrics such as time from close to configuration complete, time to first enablement session, time to first purchase, and number of onboardings in flight, and use them to find and remove delays.

### **What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 4+ years in customer onboarding, implementation, or project management in a B2B SaaS or technology environment.

  + Extra credit for supply chain, procurement, or hardware/manufacturing industry experience
* **Extreme Ownership:** You treat every onboarding as your own from handoff to enablement, and when something stalls, you find the blocker, pull in the right people, and see it through to resolution.
* **Concurrent Project Management:** A track record of running multiple customer projects at once, each with its own timeline, stakeholders, and milestones.
* **Organization and Follow-Through:** You keep a clean tracker, run tight meetings, and close loops without being reminded.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication with customers and internal teams, including the ability to push for decisions and hold stakeholders to dates.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfortable learning and configuring SaaS platforms, and able to diagnose a setup issue well enough to route it to the right person.
* **Tech Stack Experience:** Familiarity with tools like SFDC, Pylon, Notion, Gainsight, or Metabase; ability to quickly learn new platforms.
* **AI Literacy:** Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude in your daily work, for example to draft customer communications, summarize calls, build trackers, or automate repetitive steps, and the curiosity to find new ways to apply them to onboarding.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable in an early-stage environment where processes are still being built.

### **Why Join Us**

* **High Impact:** You will own the onboarding experience for every new Cofactr customer, the first impression that sets up their success on the platform.
* **Build Something New:** As the first person in this role, you will shape how Cofactr runs onboarding at scale.
* **Innovative Culture:** Join a collaborative, agile, and innovative team where your ideas and contributions matter.
* **Growth Opportunity:** Collaborate closely with CS leadership and position yourself for expanded scope as the onboarding function matures.
* **Professional Development:** Access mentorship, training, and growth opportunities within a pre-series B company.

  

If you're an organized, detail-oriented professional who likes running projects and keeping customers moving, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to join our growing team and make a meaningful difference!

  

We are an equal opportunity employer that values and welcomes diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship or immigration status, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. To conform to U.S. Government technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Technical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Revinate is the hotel data activation platform for hotels, groups, resorts, and enterprise brands.

Every hotel has that guest: years of stays, the same room, never skips the spa. But their story sits scattered across the PMS, the booking engine, the spa system, and whoever happened to be on shift. Revinate brings that story together. We connect and clean guest data from every system into Rich Guest Profile® data, then put it to work for the people who look after guests.

Reservations answers the phone already knowing the guest. Marketing sends the spa offer to the guest who raved about the spa. Behind it all, Ivy, our AI intelligence layer trained on 17 years of hospitality data, reads the patterns and handles the digital labor.

Revinate powers 1.1 billion Rich Guest Profile® data points across 12,500+ hotels, driving over $24 billion in direct revenue.

Get Revinate. Get superpowers.

The Account Configuration Specialist uses Revinate's proprietary systems to configure, customize, and install a comprehensive suite of SaaS products for new and existing clients. Beyond a single-product or strict telephony focus, this role leads the technical setup and onboarding of Revinate's entire product suite to ensure long-term success and scalable deployment. This role involves working closely with internal teams, external clients, and third-party vendors to understand requirements, navigate technical roadblocks, and ensure the accurate, timely activation of customer accounts.

### **Top 3 Outcomes for Year One**

* Develop a strong foundational knowledge of all Revinate SaaS products and the configuration processes required to implement them.

* Independently configure and manage customer accounts for multiple core product implementations simultaneously, handling both standard rollouts and complex integrations.

* Become an expert on advanced configuration requirements and tier-two tickets, providing cross-functional technical support and resolutions within designated SLA timeframes.

### **What You’ll Do**

Implementation & Project Execution

* Lead the customer implementation process end to end, serving as the primary technical point of contact to ensure on-time delivery and a smooth onboarding experience across the entire SaaS product suite.
* Gather detailed customer requirements and accurately convert them into comprehensive system configurations across multiple product lines to achieve the client's desired outcomes.
* Organize and lead effective internal and external project meetings, proactively communicating expectations, procedures, and requirements to all stakeholders.

Technical Configuration & Integration

* Execute and manage the hands-on back-end technical setup, customization, and configuration of diverse SaaS systems and solutions.
* Coordinate with third-party software vendors to acquire necessary technical details and secure required resources for complex system integrations.
* Validate the correct implementation and intended functionality of all technical components, ensuring seamless communication between internal systems and external integrations.

Quality Assurance & Troubleshooting

* Perform rigorous quality assurance (QA) and thorough testing of product functionality and performance metrics prior to project closure and official launch.
* Resolve real-time technical product issues encountered during onboarding, utilizing critical thinking to troubleshoot and perform back-end adjustments.
* Review customer inquiries, research complex technical issues, and provide timely resolutions or escalate to management and engineering when necessary.

Customer Enablement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on the platform, advising customers on how to maximize the value of their services and providing solutions for potential obstacles during live calls.
* Act as a critical liaison between the customer and internal product/engineering teams, advocating for customer-requested enhancements to drive continuous product improvement.
* Manage ongoing project documentation, including the creation, maintenance, and distribution of internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and knowledge resources to enhance service quality.

Supplementary Product Support (Telephony)

* Handle supplementary telecommunications tasks as needed, including managing toll-free and local number inventory, performing routine audits, and executing off-program workflows in accordance with carrier protocols and internal SOPs.

### **What You’ll Bring**

* An associate's degree or equivalent training, plus at least two (2) years of professional experience in a Project Management, Implementation, or Technical Configuration role.
* Demonstrated ability to successfully manage a high volume of simultaneous, ongoing implementation projects and competing priorities.
* Strong technical aptitude with a proven ability to quickly learn new SaaS technologies and master basic to intermediate product features in a fast timeframe.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify complex technical issues and evaluate, recommend, and implement back-end solutions.
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency with MS Office Suite and Google Workspace; experience using tools to track project deliverables and milestones.
* Flexible and adaptable to changing time zone requirements necessary to support internal and external customers.

Preferred Qualifications / Nice-to-Have

* Practical experience with technical SaaS software configuration and managing complex system integrations.
* Familiarity with hospitality systems, specifically Property Management Systems (PMS) such as Opera, roomMaster, or Maestro.
* Previous experience with telephony-related products, network routing, or telecom configuration.
* Experience with project management and support software such as Zendesk, JIRA, Asana, Rocketlane, Salesforce, and SendGrid.

### **People Describe You As**

* Extremely detail-oriented: You excel at following established practices and ensuring that your technical configurations are carried out with absolute precision.
* A master communicator: You are highly effective at building rapport with customers and internal teams alike. You do not hesitate to jump on a call with a customer to explain a technical setup, test an account, or troubleshoot an issue.
* Flexible and fluid: You excel at managing multiple projects with unique needs, recognizing and applying patterns to drive efficiency. You thrive on finding innovative solutions to challenges as they arise.
* Proactive and organized: You easily prioritize competing responsibilities to ensure timely completion. Whether contacting a colleague for missing integration details or updating documentation, you identify the need and take action.

Where you fall within each range depends on your skills, experience and location. If you don’t meet every qualification but think you’d be a strong fit, we encourage you to apply.

**ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION**  
ALTA Language Services is the only 100% employee-owned company in our field. As employee owners, we work hard and go beyond words to perform each and every task with integrity and a passion to stay innovative. We share three core values that guide our work: **be kind, be resourceful, and get it done**. We’re a diverse group of smart, creative people who love our work and what we learn about other languages, countries, and cultures. We offer a flexible work environment that allows us to work remotely from anywhere in the US and competitive benefits, including healthcare and company stock.

ALTA participates in E-Verify.

**DESCRIPTION**  
**About the Job**

The Training Coordinator is responsible for communications, sales, student inquiries, online training events, and administrative tasks as assigned. This is a temporary position supporting our Training team, expected to begin November 2026 and last through approximately March2027. This position is part-time, Monday through Friday, with a maximum of 29 hours per week. Hours are not guaranteed.

**Responsibilities**

Customer Service:

* Answers training inquiries both telephonically and via email.
* Promotes and sells online course offerings.
* Provides a timely response to student requests for technical or general support.
* Troubleshoots common student issues related to course access, enrollment, course progress, completion, certificates, and other LMS functionality.
* Monitors social media accounts to ensure timely response to any inquiries or questions from potential students, current students, and alumni.
* Supports corporate client onboarding, enrollment, and progress tracking, including setting up client access in the Student Journey Management tool.

Scheduling:

* Assists Customer Operations Manager in coordinating and scheduling coaching services for online students.

* Ability to independently manage multiple customer accounts and deadlines.
* Comfortable discussing financing, payment options, and financial commitments.

You'll work with an established sales team and customers who have already expressed interest in moving forward.

jobs.title: Clinical Training Specialist (RN)
jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We're constantly reimagining what's possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

*PLEASE NOTE: This is a clinical training position which requires a valid Registered Nurse license and dedicated experience as a* *clinical trainer. If you do not have these requirements, please review our other open job opportunities to determine if there is a better fit for your skills and experience. Thank you!*

  

The **Clinical Training Specialist, Medical Review Audit (RN)** owns the design, development, and delivery of post acute training programs for clinical audit staff specializing in Inpatient Psychiatric Facility (IPF), Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility (IRF), Home Health and DME claims. This is not a generalist training role. The right candidate brings deep, working knowledge of IPF and IRF documentation standards, payment systems, and medical necessity criteria alongside a demonstrated track record of building training programs that produce measurable improvements in auditor accuracy, productivity, and quality outcomes. This role requires an active nurse who can function as both a clinical subject matter expert and a skilled adult learning practitioner.

**Key Responsibilities to include:**

**Training Program Design & Development**

* Design, build, and maintain comprehensive training curricula for clinical audit nurses and audit associates covering post acute claim review, documentation requirements, medical necessity criteria, coding, and payer policy.
* Develop structured training programs, job aids, reference materials, and assessment tools for new hire onboarding, ongoing competency, performance improvement, and new program implementations.
* Translate complex clinical, regulatory, and payer-specific requirements into clear, audit-ready training content appropriate for the intended audience — including IPF PPS, IRF PPS, DSM-5 diagnostic criteria, level of care distinctions, and facility-specific billing rules, and other relevant training.
* Maintain and update training materials on a continuous basis to reflect changes in CMS payment rules, LCD/NCD policy, coding guidelines, and client-specific requirements affecting IPF and IRF audits.
* Build and manage training content within the Learning Management System (LMS); ensure materials are current, accessible, and structured for effective delivery in a remote environment.

**Training Delivery & Outcomes**

* Plan, coordinate, and deliver new hire training and ongoing education across 1:1, small group, and virtual classroom formats.
* Track and report training completion, assessment scores, and post-training performance metrics (audit accuracy, QA results, appeals outcomes); use data to evaluate program effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.
* Identify training gaps through QA results, audit performance data, appeals trends, and direct observation; develop and execute targeted remediation plans.
* Conduct User Acceptance Testing on new audit platform workflows and reporting enhancements; incorporate findings into training materials before go-live.
* Deliver training on new client implementations, new audit programs, and updated audit concepts in coordination with operations and management.

**Clinical Subject Matter Expertise**

* Serve as the primary subject matter authority for IPF audit training, including: inpatient psychiatric medical necessity criteria (vs. PHP and IOP level of care), qualifying DSM-5 diagnoses, physician certification and attestation requirements, daily progress note standards, treatment plan documentation, safety and risk assessment requirements, and ECT add-on billing under IPF PPS.
* Serve as the primary subject matter authority for IRF audit training, including: the 60%/75% compliance rule and qualifying conditions, pre-admission screening, post-admission physician evaluation timelines, IRF-PAI completion requirements, 3-hour therapy rule documentation (including exceptions), weekly interdisciplinary team conference requirements, individualized plan of care standards, and CMG assignment logic.
* Maintain current, working knowledge of IPF PPS and IRF PPS payment rules, ICD-10-CM/PCS coding applicable to inpatient psychiatric and rehabilitation claims, DRG and CMG assignment, and mental health parity compliance requirements.
* Monitor changes to CMS regulations, LCD/NCD coverage criteria, coding guidelines, and clinical standards; proactively update training content and communicate changes to audit staff.
* Provide consultative input on audit platform requirements, workflow design, and business rule development as they relate to IPF and IRF audit processes.

**Collaboration & Program Support**

* Partner with operations management, QA, and compliance to align training programs with business objectives and client contractual requirements.
* Support management in documenting workflows and process improvement plans; contribute to training-related components of new concept implementation.
* Provide input on training scheduling to ensure delivery meets operational timelines, legal requirements, and contractual obligations.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Deep working knowledge of IPF payment and documentation requirements: IPF PPS, qualifying psychiatric diagnoses and DSM-5 criteria, medical necessity standards for inpatient psychiatric care, physician certification requirements, treatment plan and daily progress note standards, safety assessment documentation, and ECT add-on billing.
* Strong command of IRF coverage and documentation requirements: IRF PPS, qualifying conditions under the 60%/75% compliance rule, pre-admission screening, IRF-PAI completion timelines, 3-hour therapy rule and exceptions, interdisciplinary team conference documentation, FIM scoring context, and CMG assignment.
* Ability to distinguish and articulate medical necessity criteria across levels of care: inpatient psychiatric vs. PHP/IOP; IRF vs. SNF — and train auditors to apply those distinctions accurately and consistently.
* Proficiency with ICD-10-CM/PCS coding for inpatient psychiatric and rehabilitation claims; working knowledge of DRG and CMG assignment logic.
* Demonstrated ability to design and deliver adult learning programs that produce measurable, documented outcomes in a clinical or healthcare audit production environment.
* Proficiency with instructional design principles, needs assessment methodology, and learning evaluation frameworks (e.g., Kirkpatrick model).
* Experience developing and managing training content in a Learning Management System (LMS).
* Strong data interpretation skills; able to analyze QA results, audit accuracy metrics, and appeals data to assess training effectiveness and identify gaps.
* Familiarity with utilization management tools such as MCG or InterQual, particularly criteria applicable to inpatient psychiatric and rehabilitation level of care determinations.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (intermediate to advanced PowerPoint, Word, and Excel); experience with curriculum development or e-learning authoring tools preferred.
* Clear, precise communicator who can translate technical clinical and billing content for audiences with varying levels of experience.

**Required Qualifications**

* Active, unrestricted nursing license in good standing; not sanctioned or excluded from the Medicare program by OIG.
* Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Health Information Management, Education, or a related field required.
* **3+ years of direct experience performing medical record audits in post acute claims (IPF and/or IRF, Home Health, DME claims) in a payer or similar audit organization is required**; experience across all or most post acute segments is strongly preferred.
* 3+ years of experience developing and delivering clinical or healthcare training programs with documented, measurable outcomes; remote learning delivery required.
* Demonstrated experience identifying training gaps from performance data and implementing remediation programs with evidence of improvement.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Nursing, Education, Health Informatics, or a related field.
* AHIMA or AAPC coding certification preferred (CPC, CCS, CCS-P, RHIT, or equivalent).
* Direct clinical experience in an inpatient psychiatric or inpatient rehabilitation setting preferred; this experience must be reflected in the candidate's nursing background, not only their audit history.
* Clinical background in inpatient psychiatric nursing, including familiarity with psychiatric assessment tools (PHQ-9, Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale, etc.), treatment planning, and level of care criteria.
* Clinical background in inpatient rehabilitation nursing, including familiarity with FIM scoring, functional goal-setting, and IRF care coordination.
* Experience with mental health parity compliance review or behavioral health utilization management in a payer or audit context.
* Prior experience in a RAC, MAC, TRICARE, or commercial payer audit environment focused on inpatient facility claims.
* Experience conducting User Acceptance Testing on audit platform or reporting system enhancements.
* Experience contributing to provider education, audit edit development, or medical policy improvement for IPF or IRF programs.

**Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify**

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Machinify is an employment at will employer. We participate in E-Verify as required by applicable law. In accordance with applicable state laws, we do not inquire about salary history during the recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruitment process, please let our recruiters know. See our Candidate Privacy Notice at: https://www.machinify.com/candidate-privacy-notice/

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant - US
jobs.description:
**Curious, hands-on and happiest in SQL? Join our Implementation team and turn raw data from some of the biggest retailers in the US into actions frontline teams actually use.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We usually respond within two weeks

**ABOUT QUORSO**
----------------

Quorso is one of retail's most exciting SaaS scale-ups. Our intelligent management platform translates terabytes of data into smart, personalized daily actions across more than 60,000 stores worldwide. Backed by Summit Partners, we're scaling fast and building the data foundations that will shape the future of retail performance.

Join Quorso at a pivotal moment in our growth. We're helping some of the world's most respected retailers rewire how they make operational decisions. Using Quorso's intelligent management platform, you'll help turn terabytes of raw store data into personalized, actionable insights, sent in near real time directly to frontline users.

We're already powering performance for some of the biggest names in retail, including Dollar General, PetSmart, Tractor Supply Company and Circle K, and we're now growing our Implementation team in the US to support new global growth.

#### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

In your first six months at Quorso, you will help rewire how global retail giants like Dollar General, PetSmart, Tractor Supply, and Circle K make operational decisions. You’ll work with terabytes of real-world store data, help find millions in operational savings, and turn them into personalized, actionable insights across more than 60,000 stores worldwide. You won’t be maintaining dashboards or sending email reports hoping someone will read them. Instead, you’ll work at the heart of near real-time, targeted, data-driven actions, sent directly to frontline users.

The best part of this role, and the hardest, is the application. Retail data reaches us raw and unstructured, and you will build pipelines to clean, join supplementary data and write logic to power the application , creating this in SQL. Once customers are live, you support and enhance the configuration, investigating failure alerts, handling support requests, and partnering with colleagues to develop new data flows. This is data-shaping, exception finding, and data-led operations at scale.

You’ll learn alongside experienced implementation leads. Learn new systems, contribute to and enhance new ways of working, and let your curiosity flourish. Implementation is a team of individuals striving to push the bounds of what is possible.

This is a fully remote role based in the US. We can only consider candidates based in the Eastern or Central time zones, to ensure good working-hours overlap with both our US and UK-based teams, including the Director of Implementation.

#### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Manage retail data from enterprise clients, shaping it in SQL into something usable: cleaning, joins, restructuring and layering on predefined and bespoke logic.
* Monitor live customers for data failures and use case up-time, investigating issues in SQL and fixing or escalating them.
* Manage support requests across customers and escalate to the appropriate channels.
* Work with customer teams and senior Implementation colleagues to understand client operations and build data-led use cases.
* Configure Quorso’s application to highlight store performance, flag improvement opportunities and measure results.
* Work with Product, Customer and Implementation team members to create a constant learning and improvement feedback loop that connects to business priorities.

#### **WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

* Hands-on SQL used to transform data, with and without AI assistance: joins, CTEs, window functions, and restructuring multi-source data. Be ready to walk us through a specific query you have written and the problem it solved. Shortlisted candidates will also be asked to complete a live SQL test.
* Experience working with large datasets and reading SQL written by others.
* The ability to turn a business problem into a well-thought-out, scalable query.

#### **EVEN BETTER IF YOU HAVE**

* Retail, FMCG or other operational data experience.
* Experience improving processes or influencing decisions through data.
* Experience working with HTML.
* Experience in a support or operations environment.

#### **IS THIS YOU?**

* You reach for SQL to solve a data problem before you reach for anything else.
* You love learning new products and tools, and when one doesn’t exist or doesn’t work the way you need, your instinct is to vibe code something that does.
* You are relentlessly curious, and you default to solving problems rather than reporting on them.
* You enjoy tracing a broken number back to its root cause and making sure it stays fixed.
* You enjoy working with data, working directly with stakeholders, and turning analysis into measurable impact.
* You stay accurate and organised when juggling several customers and requests at once.

#### **PAY AND BENEFITS**

The base salary range for this role is $90k - $110k per year. The final offer will depend on job-related factors such as skills, experience and location.

Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance; 401(k); paid time off and paid holidays; paid parental leave; other benefits.

#### **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**

Quorso is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on the skills, experience and potential people bring to the role. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please let us know.

jobs.description:
**Minimum Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree in a related field and three years of related experience. Must possess sufficient educational background and/or experience to conduct clinical applications analysis and/or programming of intermediate to complex systems, analysis of clinical workflows, and system adoption strategies. An equivalent combination of education and experience relevant to the role may be considered for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Epic Billing accreditation or certification and experience.

**Job Summary:**

This position is responsible for the design, configuration, implementation, optimization, maintenance, and support of intermediate to highly complex clinical systems in compliance with all applicable regulations and organizational policies. Clinical applications include any software application used in support of the clinical enterprise including patient registration, patient billing, clinical documentation utilized in the ambulatory and inpatient settings, as well as applications for specific medical specialties such as, but not limited to, Radiology, Pathology, Oncology, Transplant, and Cardiology. Other responsibilities include providing intermediate analysis and documentation, formulating logical statements of business and management problems to develop requirements for configuration of clinical applications, and providing solutions to intermediate to complex problems utilizing more efficient operational procedures, workflows, and information technology solutions. This role also requires an understanding of the assigned system applications, functions, and features end-users would experience.

**Job Duties:**

The Senior Epic Billing Analyst provides technical and operational expertise for Epic billing applications and revenue cycle workflows. Responsibilities include managing service requests, troubleshooting break/fix issues, and supporting system maintenance, upgrades, implementations, optimization, and process improvements.

* Senior Epic Billing Analyst Responsibilities:
* Serve as a subject matter expert in one or more Epic billing areas, including Charging, Claims, Estimates, Hospital Billing, or Professional Billing.
* Provide technical and operational support for Epic billing applications and revenue cycle workflows.
* Troubleshoot and resolve break/fix issues and service requests.
* Participate in Epic upgrades, implementations, system enhancements, maintenance, and optimization activities.
* Analyze business and operational needs and recommend effective system solutions.
* Collaborate with Revenue Cycle, Finance, clinical, and technical teams to improve workflows and system functionality.
* Configure and maintain Epic applications in accordance with organizational standards, regulatory requirements, and Epic best practices.
* Coordinate with other Epic application teams to support integrated, end-to-end workflows.
* Support projects and initiatives focused on improving billing efficiency, reimbursement accuracy, and revenue integrity.
* Share application knowledge and provide guidance to other analysts as needed.

**Salary Range:**

Actual salary commensurate with experience.

**Work Schedule:**

Remote position. 8 am to 5 pm, and as needed on occasion.
